title: Persistence logic lives in route handlers
summary: Route files issue 561 table-literal Supabase calls across 12 files versus 237 in 22 service files; route files run 2,000 to 4,000 LOC. Query, validation and ownership logic is replicated inside handler bodies.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: per-handler query shapes and 404 messages repeat (PRESSURE-46). CONFIDENCE H (grep count), functional impact U.

title: One service-role Supabase client for all backend reads and writes
summary: backend/src/config/supabase.ts reads SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and exports one client that 12 route files and 21 services import. Backend queries therefore run without RLS, and per-request isolation rests on application-level user_id checks.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: any missing user_id filter is unmitigated at DB level (see PRESSURE-47). CONFIDENCE H.

title: Frontend reads persistence directly in two places; writes always go over HTTP
summary: src contains two direct table reads (useSceneInfo scenes select; imageService projects select) and zero direct writes or storage calls. All other supabase use in src is auth.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: those two reads depend on RLS with the anon key, outside backend ownership checks. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Auth-token boilerplate repeated in each frontend service
summary: 149 'Bearer' header constructions in 22 src files and getSession calls in 23 files. No shared fetch or auth helper exists in src/lib.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: each service method reimplements session retrieval and header assembly. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Four backend route files each mix six to ten unrelated domains
summary: projects.ts (4006 LOC, 29 handlers), projectAssets.ts (3451, 37), sceneAssets.ts (2332, 36) and frames.ts (2410, 27) each host CRUD, generation, locks, continuity, location and field-version routes in one module.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: helpers are file-local (projects.ts:47-225) and change surfaces overlap across domains. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Stage components hold most state and orchestration inline
summary: Stage7ShotList (1769 LOC, 31 useState), Stage5Assets (1749, 33 useState), Stage10FrameGeneration (1754, 24 useQuery), ProjectView (994 host, 17 useState, 8 useEffect) interleave locks, autosave, polling and dialogs in single components.
notes: CONFIDENCE H (counts of hook tokens; line count exact).

title: Frame shape and status union duplicated FE and BE by hand
summary: Identical 20-field Frame interface appears in src/types/scene.ts:327 and backend frameGenerationService.ts:11; FrameStatus union appears at scene.ts:323 and frameGenerationService.ts:7 with the same five values as the DB CHECK.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: no shared source for the frame client shape; drift is undetected by the compiler across the HTTP boundary. CONFIDENCE H.

title: At least seven shot shapes in two languages and three casings
summary: Shot is typed as scene.ts:50 (22 fields, mixed camel and snake), promptGenerationService.ts:13 ShotData (21 snake), shotMergeService.ts:12 (13 snake), shotSplitService.ts:25 (10 snake), shotValidationService.ts:28 (9 camel), projects.ts:32 (3 fields), plus LLM raw shapes.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: field additions must be carried into each shape by hand. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Four different Scene shapes
summary: Scene is typed as scene.ts:76 (17 camel fields), scriptService.ts:7 (5 camel), continuityRiskAnalyzer.ts:18 SceneData (5 snake), and scriptManifest.ts:39 ScriptManifestScene (9 camel).
notes: CONFIDENCE H.

title: Scene-asset and project-asset representations diverge between FE and BE
summary: FE SceneAssetInstance (scene.ts:113, 19 snake fields) and BE SceneAssetInstanceData (promptGenerationService.ts:57, 16 fields) share 8 fields; 11 are FE-only and 8 are BE-only. The BE has no ProjectAsset type; project_assets rows are handled with `as any` (33 in routes, 17 in services).
notes: CONSEQUENCE: field drift is possible without a type error. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Stage status has three vocabularies across DB, BE/FE service types, and UI
summary: stage_states CHECK and BackendStageStatus both hold draft,locked,invalidated,outdated,skipped. UI StageStatus (types/project.ts:7) instead holds locked,active,pending,outdated,skipped, and ProjectView maps DB draft to UI active.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: UI progression is derived through a mapping, not read from the stored value. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Stage numbers map to four label sets; stage 6 has no stored state
summary: ProjectView labels stage 4 'Script', UnlockWarningDialog labels it 'Master Script' and omits stage 6, SceneWorkflowSidebar uses 'Visuals/Prompts/Frames/Review/Video', and stageInfoContent uses the long titles. Stage-range rules differ per endpoint (1-12, 1-5, [2,3,4], 7-12).
notes: CONSEQUENCE: label and range rules are maintained per file. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Case conversion is hand-written at about 520 backend and 80 frontend sites
summary: Regex counts: 385 backend camelKey-from-snake object lines and 138 snake-key-from-camel lines in routes and services; 39 and 40 in frontend. One transformer module exists (backend/src/transformers/styleCapsule.ts, 57 lines, any-typed).
notes: Counts are regex-based (CONFIDENCE M).

title: Project type literal differs between DB/backend and frontend
summary: DB CHECK and backend validation use audio_visual; frontend type and Stage 1 option use audio-visual. The backend returns 400 'Invalid project type' for the frontend value.

title: Frontend ProjectStatus type has no backing column
summary: ProjectStatus = draft|in-progress|complete|archived is declared in types/project.ts; no status column on projects appears in any migration and no ALTER adds one. 'in-progress' appears once in src.

notes: CONSEQUENCE: the Stage 9 capsule block at projects.ts:3739-3749 never loads a capsule. Wave-1 C02 confirmed. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Style-capsule loading copied four times with three failure policies
summary: The load-capsule-for-project block exists in frames.ts (twice), frameGenerationService.ts and projects.ts, with empty catches at frames.ts:573, :2220 and frameGenerationService.ts:786, and a warn-only catch at projects.ts:3747. getCapsuleById has 7 callers.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: a failed capsule load is indistinguishable from no capsule in the two frames.ts copies. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Location context reloaded per request and resolved per shot
summary: loadProjectLocationContext has 13 references (12 in projects.ts). The shot list GET maps transformShotForClient across all shots; each call runs buildShotLocationState, which calls resolveShotLocation, with no batch path.

title: LLM default model differs by path within one file
summary: llm-client.ts uses GEMINI_MODEL with fallback gemini-2.5-flash-lite in the constructor (:76) and estimateCost (:310) but gemini-1.5-flash in generate (:106); generate builds a new client per request with the resolved model.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: cost estimates and actual requests can refer to different models when GEMINI_MODEL is unset. CONFIDENCE H.

GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY is checked at llm-client.ts:91, imageAnalysisService.ts:25-27, NanoBananaClient.ts:21-23 and reported by llm.ts:143.

title: Veo variant and rate branching duplicated across backend and frontend
summary: The 0.15/0.40 rate appears at videoGenerationService.ts:6-7, Veo3Provider.ts:158, MockVideoProvider.ts:44 and checkoutService.ts:243; 'veo_3_1_fast' appears 12 times in backend and 10 in frontend; ModelVariant is defined in three places.

title: Video provider silently defaults to mock
summary: createVideoProvider uses VIDEO_PROVIDER || 'mock' with a process-wide singleton; Veo3Provider throws only on first use when GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT is missing.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: an unset env yields mock output with no startup error. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Token budgets and temperatures are literals at call sites
summary: maxTokens and temperature literals appear 22 times each in backend services; route cap is 8192 (llm.ts:25,56); default is 4096 (llm-client.ts:137); frontend sends no maxTokens. The treatment seed asks for three 800-1200 word treatments.
notes: Wave-1 PRESSURE-0001 partially re-checked; truncation behaviour not runtime-tested. CONFIDENCE M.

title: Prompt builders duplicated by name and by inline text
summary: buildSystemPrompt and buildUserPrompt are each defined in two streamline services; 19 backend files embed 'You are' system prompt text; visual-style context builders exist in assetExtractionService.ts:657 and ImageGenerationService.ts:639.
notes: CONFIDENCE H.

title: Two independent scene parsers; Stage 1 duplicates the Stage 4 approve path
summary: Frontend scriptService.extractScenes (9 call sites) produces the persisted scene list; backend extractManifest (8 call sites) produces the TipTap dependency manifest. Stage1InputMode repeats extraction and persistScenes inline with the comment 'replicate it here'.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: scene identity and dependency identity come from different parsers of the same script. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Deprecated LLM dependency path reachable from scene save
summary: sceneDependencyExtraction is marked @deprecated but is called from PUT /scenes whenever the dependency map is empty, including when the deterministic manifest ran and matched nothing; manifest errors also fall through to it.
notes: Condition is code-verified; runtime frequency UNKNOWN. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Script approve writes stage 4 twice and can delete scenes with cascades
summary: Stage4 persistScenes, then lockStage(4) in the component, then onComplete leads to a second lockStage(4) from ProjectView; the lock route has no already-locked guard, and unmatched scenes are hard-deleted (cascading to shots, scene_asset_instances, video jobs, image jobs, suggestions, transformation events).
notes: CONSEQUENCE: two stage_states version rows per approve; removed scenes take dependent rows with them. Wave-1 C15 re-checked. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Shot-list lock written to three places by three calls
summary: shots/lock writes scenes.shot_list_locked_at and stage_locks['7']; stage-locks/7/lock writes scenes.stage_locks again; ProjectView handleSceneStageComplete calls sceneStageLockService.lockStage a third time. The 014 trigger changes only scenes.status.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: 'Stage 7 locked' has no single writer. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Shot-list unlock uses two systems and touches tables with no migration
summary: Stage7 confirms the stage-lock unlock then calls shotService.unlockShotList best-effort; the unlock route updates frames (status 'invalidated', not in CHECK) and videos (table not created by any migration), inserts invalidation_logs (not created by any migration, guarded by a comment 'if invalidation_logs table exists'), and reads counts with unchecked errors.
notes: In-repo migrations imply the frame UPDATE violates CHECK and the videos count returns an error that is not read, so videosAffected is 0. Live DB state UNKNOWN. CONFIDENCE H (code), U (runtime). Tested by shotLocking4_5_task_11.test.ts 409 path with mocked supabase only.

title: Shot mutations do not consult the shot-list lock
summary: Seven shot-mutating handlers (reorder, camera-direction, location, PUT shot, split, merge, DELETE shot) never reference shot_list_locked_at; lock state is read only in the scene list GET and the lock/unlock handlers. No migration RAISE touches shot writes.
notes: Wave-1 C05 confirmed; enforcement is UI-only. RAISE statements exist only in migrations 041-044. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Asset lock is one-way and not enforced on generation or upload
summary: project_assets.locked is set true at projectAssets.ts:1565 and :1729 and set false only in create and clone paths; no route unlocks; generate-image, upload-image, analyze-image and edit-image contain no locked check.
notes: Wave-1 C20 confirmed. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Style change fans out through three mechanisms that do not share state
summary: Stage 5 style lock is client content autosaved to stage_states; mark-outdated sets project_assets.style_outdated; clear-images nulls image keys. Frame generation reads a different capsule source (PRESSURE-17) and the project column has no writer (PRESSURE-18).
notes: CONSEQUENCE: the style id that frames read is not the one stage 5 writes. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Scene defer is a single column with a local-only UI reaction
summary: scenes.is_deferred is written at projects.ts:1163 and 1204 and read only by the scene list (projects.ts:1042,1119) and the Stage 6 UI; Stage6ScriptHub patches local state without query invalidation; no service-layer reader exists.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: deferred state is not consumed by backend generation or shot code paths. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Stage lock depends on a row that only a prior save creates
summary: POST stages/:n/lock returns 404 when no stage_states row exists for the branch and stage; rows are inserted only by the PUT handler; project creation inserts no stage rows.
notes: Wave-1 C21 re-checked on the lock side. Whether the UI can reach lock before any save was not run. CONFIDENCE H on code.

title: Stage 8 auto-populate runs once per mount, sequentially, and swallows failure
summary: Stage8VisualDefinition runs inheritAssets then populateFromDependencies for scene 2+, guarded by a ref, and its catch logs and comments 'Silently fail'.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: a failed populate yields an empty scene with no visible error, and the ref blocks retry within the mount. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Long-running jobs run in-process without a recovery path
summary: Image and video jobs start fire-and-forget; VideoJobExecutor guards concurrency with a module-level boolean; no code re-queues processing rows (grep for stuck, recover, orphan, requeue returns no relevant hits).
notes: Runtime recovery behaviour UNKNOWN. CONFIDENCE H on code.

title: Polling is the orchestration mechanism for several generation views
summary: Six refetchInterval or setInterval sites and three setTimeout poll loops in src drive progress views; the backend polls Veo operations and the job queue.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: UI progress depends on refetch cadence and on backend terminal statuses being written. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Lock writes are duplicated between component and shell
summary: Stage 4 issues two stage locks, Stage 7 three scene-lock writes, and Stage 12 a best-effort lock in the component plus ProjectView's handleSceneStageComplete.
notes: CONFIDENCE H.

title: Route error handling responds, with two empty catches on the frame path
summary: Of 197+13+3+2+2 route catch blocks, 197 respond to the client, 13 only log, 3 log and fall back, 2 are empty (frames.ts:573, 2220), and 2 fall back silently. Six fire-and-forget .catch sites do not await invalidation.
notes: Classification by catch-body regex. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Supabase results are frequently unread in routes and services
summary: Regex counts: 136 single-line destructures without error, 53 bare await-supabase statements in routes, 32 in services. The unlock path reads counts and writes frames and videos without checking errors.
notes: Upper bound: errors may be read on a following line. CONFIDENCE M.

title: Frontend catch blocks are mostly log-only or empty
summary: src non-test catch blocks: 19 empty, 102 console-only, 81 other.
notes: Classification by regex over catch bodies. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Project ownership re-implemented in each handler
summary: Of 176 project-scoped handlers, 158 contain an inline from('projects') ownership lookup and 150 return a literal 'Project not found'; .eq('user_id', userId) appears 167 times in routes; the one shared helper (shotAssignments.ts:36) is used only inside its own file.
notes: CONSEQUENCE: each handler carries its own copy and 404 wording varies. CONFIDENCE H.

title: Seven transformation-event handlers have no ownership check
summary: GET, POST, PUT, confirm, DELETE, generate-post-description and generate-prefill under /:projectId/scenes/:sceneId/transformation-events never reference the user; their service methods take no user argument, and the backend client is service-role.
notes: Sibling handler sceneAssets.ts:1944 does check ownership. No route-level test covers these handlers. Runtime exploitability not tested (no request executed). CONFIDENCE H (code).

title: Prompt template read path has no owner check
